turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick check on the citation for that dataset paper I found this morning. Who are Kim et al. exactly?
Kim et al. are the authors of the DialSim dataset paper.
Got it. Also, my coffee maker is leaking again. Any tips for a quick fix before I buy a new one?
Check the gasket seal first. If it's worn, replacing it might solve the leak. Otherwise, descaling could help if mineral buildup is causing a poor seal.
I'll try that. By the way, is it going to rain this afternoon? I was thinking of walking to the library.
The forecast shows a 20% chance of showers after 4 PM, so you should be fine if you leave now.
Great. Thanks for the help with the paper citation too.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need anything else.
Lloyd, I was looking into some voice tech companies this morning. Can you remind me what Plivo is associated with?
Plivo is associated with Venky B and the topic of Voice Agent Failure Modes.
Right, Venky B. Okay. Also, my hard drive order from last week finally arrived. The box was dented, but the drive seems okay.
It's good the drive survived. You might want to run a SMART test just to be safe.
I will. Do you think I need to return it if the SMART test fails?
Most retailers have a 30-day return policy for defective hardware, so yes, you should be covered.
No problem. Keep me posted on the test results.
